summary: Iter145 — Task 2 visibility fix follow-up. ALL 13/13 backend tests PASS. The `_story_is_visible_to` bypass for `is_bot=True` (server.py:7285-7300) is correctly implemented and closes the Task 2 gap without introducing regressions on real-user stories. Verified end-to-end: (1) admin + fresh non-admin users both now see bot authors in /api/stories/feed (bucket ≤8 confirmed, order deterministic per UTC day, no duplicates with circle); (2) /api/stories/user/{bot_id} returns the bot's stories to any real caller (admin + fresh user); (3) non-bot users OUT of the caller's circle stay invisible in both /feed and /user/{id} endpoints — Cerchia gate intact; (4) positive control confirmed: non-bot user IN circle becomes visible; (5) story_hidden_viewers still blocks, tested both for bot authors (viewer added to bot's hidden list → NOT visible) and for non-bot authors even WITH friendship edge; (6) hot_news fanout regression from Task 3 still working (admin gets notification, 0 bots receive it). No new issues found.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py::_story_is_visible_to — implementation is clean and matches the recommended patch exactly: (a) self-view short-circuit first, (b) single DB read pulling only is_bot + story_hidden_viewers, (c) hidden_viewers check runs BEFORE the bot bypass so hidden takes precedence over the broadcast rule (correct precedence for both bots and non-bots), (d) friendship edge check only for real-user authors. Inline comment block (lines 7285-7291) documents the product intent clearly.
The single-read + set-membership check for hidden_viewers is efficient — no extra DB round-trip for the common bot case (no friendships lookup happens at all when is_bot=True and viewer not hidden).
seed_data_creation: One ephemeral email/pwd user per run (test_iter145_<hex>@populus-it.co) created via /api/auth/signup, then email_verified flipped to True in DB before token minting. Ephemeral non-bot authors (TEST_iter145_author_<hex>, TEST_iter145_friend_<hex>, TEST_iter145_hidauth_<hex>) inserted with their own stories to test circle-gate and hidden-viewers regressions; all cleaned up in test finally blocks. One TEST_-prefixed feud + 3 comments for hot_news fanout, cleaned up. Bot authors' story_hidden_viewers list mutated briefly then rolled back with $pull. Admin's favorite_categories/push_notifications set to include 'gossip' (idempotent). No bot user_id created or deleted.
